description: This file defines the GatewayConnectConfig struct, which encapsulates configuration details for connecting to a gateway in the iOS app. It includes properties for URL, tokens, TLS parameters, and connection options, along with derived properties like effectiveStableID.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: A configuration structure for managing gateway connection parameters, including connection URLs, tokens, TLS settings, and connection options. It provides a method to derive a stable identifier for persistence purposes.

methods.name: effectiveStableID
methods.description: A computed property that returns a non-empty, trimmed identifier for gateway-scoped persistence, falling back to the URL string if the stableID is empty.
